_doc: S35c: the coach's clothes that bend with the body, built per coach figure by tools/blender/characters/coach_garment.py into out/garments/<figure>/<name>.glb. kind: torso | pants | skirt | boots. bands: [from, to, colour] along the garment (0 top hem, 1 bottom hem); base: the rest. The other keys tune the cut (see DEFAULTS in the script).
